slice: NORTHERN local districts (Bình Thạnh / Gò Vấp / Tân Bình-Tân Phú). SEPARATE from the other CREATORS_HCMC*.json files.
note: WebSearch-only research from a US region, and the shared WebSearch budget was fully exhausted (200/200) partway through this wave. Per the honesty rule I did NOT invent any individual Vietnamese TikTok/YouTube/IG food vlogger, clip, or follower count — none could be verified with a findable clip on a specific northern-district place before budget ran out. The one vetted independent creator-authored source below counts as ONE corroborating source, never an authority. A follow-up local-language pass (Vietnamese YouTube/TikTok/VnExpress/Tuổi Trẻ) is required to (a) add named vloggers with follower scale and (b) secure the missing second credible source for the single-credible LEADS documented in _note_hcmc_north.md.
